Gold Rate Today: Gold prices in India slight down on July 28, 2026, offering slightly slip for jewellery buyers and investors despite the market fluctuations. According to the latest market data, 24-carat gold is trading at ₹14,417 per gram today. Although prices have seen a drop from recent levels, gold continues to trade near historic highs, supported by global economic uncertainty.

Indianews updates

Gold rates have shown steady strength since the beginning of the year, supported by increased demand for safe-haven assets. Market volatility and weakness in equity markets encouraged many investors to shift part of their investments into gold, boosting its appeal. Although gold traded within a relatively narrow range over the past few years, renewed economic uncertainty has helped revive investor interest. Below are today’s gold rates in Delhi for buyers and investors tracking the precious metal market.

LIVE Gold Rate Today | Domestic Gold Prices (India) – 28 July 2026

MCX Performance

  • Revenue more than doubled: Consolidated revenue jumped 205% year-on-year to ₹889 crore in the latest quarter.
  • Strong profit growth: Quarterly net profit surged 301.9% YoY to ₹409 crore, reflecting robust earnings momentum.
  • Higher operating margins: EBITDA margin expanded to 74.9%, improving by 1,995 basis points from a year earlier, driven by stronger operating efficiency.
  • Consistent long-term earnings: The exchange has delivered an impressive 48.7% compound annual growth rate (CAGR) in profit over the past five years.

Gold & Silver Rate Today: Why Gold and Silver Are Changing?

Gold and silver prices traded higher in both global and domestic markets. In international trade, spot gold climbed 1.3% to around $4,105 per ounce, while spot silver advanced 3% to trade above $59 per ounce. In India’s Multi Commodity Exchange (MCX), 24K gold futures gained nearly 0.50% to ₹1,43,784 per 10 grams, whereas silver futures rose more than 1% to ₹2,24,550 per kg

Can Gold Prices Rise Again?

  • The geopolitical situation remains tense around the world which makes people look for a safe haven.
  • Central banks continue to buy up gold strongly.
  • A depreciated US dollar can drive up the price of bullion.
  • Low-interest rate environment is always good for gold.
  • Demand for gold during festivals in India can boost buying.
  • Analysts suggest that prices can rise if there will be more uncertainty in the global economy.

Key Considerations for Buyers

  • Compare the rate at several jewellers.
  • Ensure that the jewel is BIS Hallmarked.
  • Confirm making charges prior to buying.
  • Add GST and extra charges to the total cost.
  • It may be better to buy during price corrections.
  • Be aware of the dynamics of the international market.
  • Gold ETFs and Sovereign Gold Bonds continue to be investment options.

What Will Happen To Gold If Fed Begins Raising Rates?

US interest rates have been historically lower than other interest rates because whenever there is an increase in interest rates, the attraction towards non-interest earning assets like gold decreases. In case the US Fed decides to hike rates further and it would make the US dollar stronger and put short term pressure on gold prices however, there will be certain factors that will help gold overcome this weakness.

Should You Buy Gold Today Or Hold Back in India?

Whether this is the right time to buy gold depends on your investment objectives and time horizon. However, most market experts currently recommend buying in phases through staggered investments instead of waiting for a significant correction in prices.

In the domestic market, gold is trading in the ₹1,43,000–₹1,45,000 per 10 grams range. Although prices may remain volatile in the short term due to geopolitical developments and India’s recent increase in import duty to 15%, analysts believe the long-term outlook for gold remains positive. Rather than trying to predict the exact market bottom, experts advise gradually building positions over time.
